introHtml: Custom sunscreen with carabiner clips makes it easy for outdoor workers and event attendees to keep sun protection within reach. Attach to belt loops, backpacks, or tool belts for hands-free carry. Perfect for construction crews, field staff, or outdoor promotional giveaways where convenience matters. Choose from SPF 30 or 50 lotions and sprays with your logo imprinted on the bottle or carabiner tag.
